title: Letter 3
paragraphs: I'm writing quickly to say I'm safe and making good progress. This letter will reach England on a merchant ship now heading home from Archangel — luckier than me, who may not see my homeland for many years. But I'm in good spirits. My men are bold and seem resolute. The sheets of floating ice that drift past us constantly, warning of the dangers ahead, don't seem to frighten them. We've already reached a very high latitude. It's the height of summer, and though not as warm as England, the southern winds that blow us swiftly toward the shores I so long to reach carry a reviving warmth I hadn't expected.

Nothing noteworthy has happened so far. A couple of strong gales and a sprung leak are the kind of incidents experienced sailors barely bother to record. I'll be grateful if nothing worse happens during our voyage.
Goodbye, dear Margaret. Rest assured that for my own sake as well as yours, I won't recklessly seek out danger. I'll be cool, persistent, and careful.

But success _shall_ crown my efforts. Why not? I've come this far, tracing a safe course over pathless seas, with the very stars as witnesses to my triumph. Why not continue over this untamed yet obedient element? What can stop the determined heart and resolved will of man?
My swelling heart pours itself out like this involuntarily. But I must stop. Heaven bless my beloved sister!
